subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be consolidated into existing sub-agent prompt/tool-description guidance, or should OpenClaw intentionally change nested sub-agent policy?
rationale: Current main already has several sub-agent guidance surfaces and supports configured nested spawning, so the right outcome depends on maintainer prompt-policy direction rather than a mechanical patch.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only non-duplicative examples and merge them into the current availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and child prompts together instead of changing this prompt text alone.

options.title: Pause Or Close As Covered
options.body: If current main's merged guidance is sufficient, defer this stale branch rather than adding another model-facing policy surface.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only non-duplicative examples and merge them into the current availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision turns on nested sub-agent semantics introduced and tested through the nested orchestration work.
